brief: A base with a bay bin in one half of its cell.

requirements.requirement: A base (hex base cells) to carry the bay
requirements.evidence: Three full bases at (1,-1,0), (0,-1,0) and (-1,0,0) sit around the empty cell (0,0,0). A bay can only stand in an empty cell with three bases beside it.

requirements.requirement: A bay bin filling one half of the cell
requirements.evidence: bay:0#0,0#bay1 is the half bay tray hex-bin-bay-n-half-solid at cell (0,0,0). It fills the north half and bolts to all three bases.
check_build reports no errors and meshClash is 'clear'.

finish.summary: A half bay tray sits in the north half of cell (0,0,0), bolted to three full bases around it. check_build is clean and the mesh check is clear.

lines.label: M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
